title: MagicDrive-V2: High-Resolution Long Video Generation for Autonomous Driving with Adaptive Control
control_family: layout, box, map or BEV conditioning

output_modality.value: multi-view video, 6 cameras, up to 848x1600 and 241 frames in a single inference

control_signal.value: per-frame BEV road map, 3D bounding boxes, ego trajectory, camera poses, and text (weather, time, richer MLLM-generated captions)

control_mechanism.value: cross-attention for text, boxes, camera and trajectory; additive ControlNet-style branch for maps; spatial-temporal encoders aligned to 3D VAE latents (downsampling plus temporal transformer with RoPE)

base_model.value: STDiT-3 DiT blocks with a new multi-view cross-view attention block, CogVideoX 3D VAE, rectified-flow loss; diffusion trained from scratch, no pretrained video backbone

datasets.value: nuScenes (700 train, 150 val videos, 2Hz annotations interpolated to 12Hz); Waymo Open Dataset fine-tuning with 3 front views

metrics.value: Video: FVD; controllability via BEVFormer mAP (3D detection) and mIoU (BEV segmentation). Image: FID, BEVFusion mAP, CVT road mIoU. Also a human consistency study.

controllability_evidence.value: Table 2 on nuScenes val: FVD 94.84, mAP 18.17, mIoU 20.40 versus MagicDrive (16f) 218.12, 11.86, 18.34. Box spatial-temporal encoding ablated against a global reduce baseline in Fig. 10.

closed_loop.value: No: open-loop generation from given conditions in one inference (up to 241 frames); rollout inference is described as degrading quality, so it is avoided. No driving policy loop.

notes: Packet has no limitations passage; the rollout-degradation remark is about prior methods. Could also be labelled multi-condition control (geometry plus text).
